script.base: No book spread or total is saved, so the lead is not priced. From weeks 1-2 form the lean is a competitive, run-tilted game: LA's committee (Kyren Williams 23/126, Blake Corum 22/133) faces a DEN front that has allowed 5.41 YPC and 7 runs of 10+, while Stafford is worse vs the blitz (EPA/db -0.16 blitzed vs +0.22 clean) and DEN blitzes 34%, so LA should hand it off and throw quick rather than live on Davante Adams's 16.9 aDOT. DEN, with Jonah Coleman out, feeds J.K. Dobbins early; Bo Nix is -0.55 EPA/db vs blitz and LA blitzes 30%, so Denver's throws skew short to Evan Engram and R.J. Harvey unless a coverage bust appears.
script.flip1: LA falls behind and abandons the run. Corum and Williams rush yards stall (the DAL-style clock-kill in reverse), and Adams, Terrance Ferguson (10 targets, 54 yards) and Konata Mumpfield absorb Puka Nacua's 9 targets if Nacua sits. Corum over 48 does not survive this flip — tag script-dependent.
script.flip2: LA leads late and clocks it with both backs, so Dobbins's carries die and DEN throws to catch up (Harvey, Engram, Jaylen Waddle volume up). A second break is neither blitz getting home: Adams (271 air yards) and Waddle (166 air yards, games of 2 and 138) both clear and any unknown total goes over. Kinchens Doubtful is the coverage version of that break.

Adams (271 air) overlaps DEN's left-side YPA and 5 explosives but conflicts with the 34% blitz. Waddle is DEN's top target (13/140/166) but attacks deep, where LA has been stingy, unless Kinchens sits — that is a news overlap, not a charted one. Sutton (9 targets, 36 yards, 71 air) does not attack LA's middle bleed.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both leans lost. Corum finished under 48 because the unpublished spread had LA chasing, Williams took the usable carries (he already had a 41-yard game in this split), and the 79 was one explosive against a DEN front that sold out once the blitz was forcing Stafford checkdowns instead of runs. Engram finished under 21 because Denver handed Coleman’s 5 carries a game to Dobbins, Nix took two sacks and checked to Harvey (already 4 targets at -22 air) and Trautman, and the 17-yard game was the real role — 6 targets in two weeks — while the 43 was a one-game spike. The middle 6.29 YPA sat on 14 attempts and did not repeat. No price was ever posted that beat a sharp anchor, so there was nothing to bet. The counter-case is as strong as the Engram read and nearly as strong as Corum’s; both stay leans for a human, not confirms.
slip_story: One story only: both blitz problems, not a shootout. LA runs into a soft DEN front (Corum rush over 48) because Stafford is negative vs DEN's 34% blitz. DEN, at -0.55 EPA vs LA's 30% blitz, throws short over the middle (Engram rec over 21). Do not add Adams over, Waddle over, Ferguson over 50.5, or any total over — those need clean pockets and explosives, the opposite script. Do not add Dobbins over in the same slip as a second DEN volume leg without a spread. No TD legs. No receptions markets. Max two edge players; this is the whole card. Not a placed bet.
